destinations.d: Known simply as The Mara, this vast reserve in Narok borders Tanzania’s Serengeti and is named for the Maasai people. “Mara” means “spotted”, for the bushy trees dotting the plains.
l: Big cats and the Big Five

destinations.d: Famous for large elephant herds and postcard views of Mount Kilimanjaro across the plains.
A compact Rift Valley park built around a soda lake, known for birdlife and both black and white rhinos.
Nairobi National Park sits minutes from the skyline, with lions, rhinos and giraffes, plus the Giraffe Centre and elephant orphanage.
A rugged northern reserve along the Ewaso Ng’iro river, home to species rarely seen elsewhere in Kenya.
Vast wilderness split into Tsavo East and West, known for red-dust elephants and wide open landscapes.
Kenya’s coast pairs white-sand beaches with centuries of Swahili history, ideal after a bush safari.
A freshwater lake with hippos, birdlife and easy outdoor activities close to Nairobi.
A highland town on the equator, base for Mount Kenya and conservancies such as Ol Pejeta.
A highland range of moorland, forest and waterfalls, with wildlife seen from lodges overlooking waterholes.
A glaciated equatorial mountain with treks through forest, bamboo and moorland.
Uganda’s largest park, where the Nile forces through a narrow gorge into a thundering waterfall.
An ancient rainforest sheltering roughly half of the world’s mountain gorillas.
A freestanding volcano rising 5,895 m, with several routes from rainforest to glaciers.
Tanzania’s iconic park, adjoining the Mara, famed for the year-round movement of the wildebeest herds.

Lift off at sunrise for a sweeping view of the savannah and its wildlife from above.

faq: Send us your dates and group size through the contact page or WhatsApp. We reply with a plan and a price, and nothing is booked until you confirm.
Yes. Every package is a starting point and can be tailored to your dates, group and interests.
When is the best time to go?
The Mara migration is generally July to October, while January and February are good dry-season months across Kenya. We advice our clients on the best places to visit and match their itinerary.
Do you offer Uganda and Tanzania trips?
Yes. We arrange trips to Murchison Falls, Bwindi, Kilimanjaro and the Serengeti on request.
Is support available during my trip?
Yes, our team offers 24/7 support to clients. The driver assigned to your trip becomes your guide through most of the trip.
